_doc: Methodology copy for scatter filter tabs — opened in the entity drawer on Layer / Quadrant chip click. Framed as thesis predictions at point of use.

exposed.body: Exposure runs ahead of preparedness: high non-firm intensity, concentration, or trigger gap without the data, products, capital and modelling to carry it. Cut rule: exposure at or above the universe median and preparedness below. This is the minority a damage-first read hides — losses concentrate here when curtailment bites and wordings still wait on physical cause.

earning_it.body: Exposed and prepared enough to match: real non-firm load with balance sheet, products and register-backed measurement behind it. Cut rule: both axes at or above the universe median. The quadrant the market should reward if triggers and registers stay aligned.

whitespace.body: Preparedness exceeds exposure: rated paper, product fit and underwriting depth exist, but the non-firm book has not yet caught up. Cut rule: exposure below median, preparedness at or above. Findings prediction two: autopilot deployment timing — who writes register-native cover before queue repricing closes the window.

sidelined.body: Neither materially exposed nor yet prepared to underwrite non-firm power risk. Cut rule: both axes below the universe median. Often generalist carriers, early-stage MGAs, or assets still on firm connections — the field most desks would pass without a second axis.

1.title: Carriers & syndicates
1.body: Placement posture above: balance-sheet writers where preparedness is easier to evidence from filings than curtailment exposure is to see from the outside. Exposure is energy and data-centre premium concentration; preparedness is capital (FSR/SCR), product breadth, curtailment pricing and aggregation modelling.

2.title: MGAs & brokers
2.body: Intelligence-heavy placement layer: price and place without mostly carrying the balance sheet. Exposure is non-firm risk routed through facilities; preparedness is the products they can structure and expertise to match trigger to curtailment exposure.

3.title: Energy & data-centre assets
3.body: Register facts below: originate the exposure. Findings prediction three expects Exposed to skew here — flexible-connection share and NESO Gate / DNO ECR queue position land before mitigation evidence propagates up the tower.
3.role: Examples: data centres, batteries on Gate-1 / curtailable connections
